note: Fit-audit repaint 2026-10-21 (hook standard v2). Bar-counter close-up: all six words are masculine and stand on the right of the divider (sign, plant and stool form the setting on the left). One box per item; zoom_back bottom-left.

items.label: le cabaret
items.scene: Same as English 'cabaret' (said kah-bah-REH): a frog in a top hat sings on a tiny CABARET stage at the end of the bar.

items.label: le couscous
items.scene: Same as English 'couscous' (said koos-KOOS): a steaming dome of COUSCOUS crowned with vegetables in a painted dish.

items.label: le restaurateur
items.scene: Same as English 'restaurateur' (said rehs-toh-rah-TUHR): the proud RESTAURANT OWNER, a silver-haired lady, counts the day's takings beside her brass till.

items.label: le banquet
items.scene: Same as English 'banquet' (said bahn-KEH, no 't'): a long BANQUET platter piled with a roast, grapes and bread.

items.label: l'hors-d'œuvre
items.scene: Same as English 'hors d'oeuvre' (said or-DUHVR): a little tray of STARTERS, cheese and tomatoes on cocktail sticks.

items.label: le bistro
items.scene: Same as English 'bistro' (said bees-TROH): a tiny model BISTRO with a red awning sits in a snow globe on the bar.
